definition: Type Hinting is a core concept in Python Training Course. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Type Hinting is
theory.body: Type Hinting describes the methods and patterns used within Python Training Course to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Type Hinting is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Type Hinting matters
theory.body: Without Type Hinting, systems built with Python Training Course are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Type Hinting works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Type Hinting follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Type Hinting.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Type Hinting
theory.body: Type Hinting offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
